transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?

I've been feeling really overwhelmed lately and finding it hard to cope with everything going on. I'm struggling with a mix of low mood and constant anxiety, and it's making it really difficult to get through my daily routine.
How long have you been feeling this way, and did these symptoms start after a specific stressful event or change in your life?
I've been feeling this way for about four months now. It actually started about two months after I went through a really difficult breakup and had to move out of my apartment.
Have you ever experienced periods of time lasting a few days or more where you felt the opposite—unusually energetic, hyperactive, or needing very little sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I've actually felt the opposite, mostly just feeling really exhausted and drained.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in doing things you normally enjoy, or are you still able to find some joy in your daily activities?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't really thought about whether I've lost interest in things, since I've just been so focused on trying to get through each day.
You mentioned having constant anxiety. Is this worry focused mainly on the breakup and your new living situation, or do you find yourself worrying excessively about many different areas of your life?

My anxiety is definitely focused on the breakup and trying to settle into my new living situation. I don't really worry about other areas of my life; it's just this specific situation that feels so overwhelming.
How have your sleep and appetite been since these feelings started?
I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep or appetite since all of this started. They both seem to be pretty much the same as they were before.
Have you experienced any feelings of worthlessness, excessive guilt, or thoughts of suicide or self-harm during this time?
No, I haven't experienced any of those feelings. I don't feel worthless or guilty, and I definitely haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or suicide.
